pattern.top_pattern: SNF costs are rising outside GA through a mix of rate pressure and emerging volume
key_driver_codes: Aftercare, Musculoskeletal System and Connective Tissue with CC
Other Circulatory System Diagnoses with CC
pattern.pattern_details: Outside GA, PPO Local SNF spend is increasing across several states, with different mixes of price and volume pressure. CA and NY are more clearly unit-cost-led, while PA and the smaller CA / OH pattern show a mix of added claims and higher paid amounts. This is a post-acute reimbursement and care-routing issue that should be handled separately from acute hospital work.
pattern.why_it_matters: Post-acute cost pressure can persist after inpatient discharge and may require different network and UM levers than hospital trends.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Review SNF reimbursement and discharge-routing practices in CA, PA, NY, and OH, prioritizing musculoskeletal aftercare and cerebrovascular recovery pathways where paid per claim is rising fastest.
evidence_summary: CA SNF added +$127K despite 12 fewer claims, with about +$860 higher paid per claim.
PA SNF added +$109K on 12 more claims, with about +$8.4K higher paid per claim.
NY SNF added +$29K with flat volume, with about +$7.2K higher paid per claim.
A smaller CA / OH SNF pattern added +$51K across circulatory and cerebrovascular recovery cases.
